description: This file contains unit tests for the CommandResolver component of the OpenClaw project, specifically testing command construction logic, path preference, and SSH command generation.

classes.name: CommandResolverTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying CommandResolver behavior in various scenarios including path resolution, fallback mechanisms, and remote command generation.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates a UserDefaults instance with a unique suite name for isolated test configurations.

methods.name: makeLocalDefaults
methods.description: Sets up a UserDefaults instance with local connection mode for testing.

methods.name: makeProjectRootWithPnpm
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory, sets it as project root, and prepares a pnpm executable for testing command paths.

methods.name: prefers open claw binary
methods.description: Tests that the command prefers the openclaw binary when available in the project bin directory.

methods.name: falls back to node and script
methods.description: Verifies fallback logic when the openclaw binary is not present, ensuring it uses node and a script.

methods.name: prefers open claw binary over pnpm
methods.description: Tests that the command prefers the openclaw binary over the pnpm binary when both are available.

methods.name: uses open claw binary without node runtime
methods.description: Checks that the command uses the openclaw binary directly without falling back to node in certain conditions.

methods.name: falls back to pnpm
methods.description: Ensures the command correctly falls back to using pnpm when the openclaw binary is not present.

methods.name: pnpm keeps extra args after subcommand
methods.description: Verifies that additional arguments are preserved after the subcommand when constructing the command.

methods.name: preferred paths start with project node bins
methods.description: Checks that the preferred paths list begins with the project's node_modules/.bin directory.

methods.name: builds SSH command for remote mode
methods.description: Tests the construction of an SSH command with remote connection parameters.

methods.name: rejects unsafe SSH targets
methods.description: Verifies that unsafe or malformed SSH targets are rejected.

methods.name: config root local overrides remote defaults
methods.description: Checks that local configuration overrides remote defaults when constructing commands.
